name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST With TWO Prior Apprenticeships (Same Course), Approved, Then Withdrawal PUT Silently Ignored
description: Extends 'Apprenticeship — Draft POST With TWO Prior Apprenticeships (Same Course, PROD-like)': same setup (two approved, untouched prior ApprenticeshipLearning rows for standard 21, PROD-like with no completion/withdrawal info), and the same third draft POST for standard 21. This time the draft is then approved via ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent — SelectExistingLearningToUpdate matches the single unapproved draft row (neither prior qualifies, both being approved and not-removed) so the correct third row is approved, not one of the two priors. The learner now has THREE approved, non-removed ApprenticeshipLearning rows on standard 21. SLD then PUTs a withdrawal date, addressed only by (LearnerKey, Ukprn, TrainingCode). Per FLP-2087's agreed decision, UpdateLearnerCommandHandler can't disambiguate which of the three rows the PUT belongs to, so it silently ignores the update: 200 response, no repository writes, none of the three rows gets a WithdrawalDate. Confirms that behaviour end-to-end rather than the pre-FLP-2087 InvalidOperationException.

assertions.name: Draft POST succeeds (course-scoped query with 2 same-course prior rows doesn't cause ambiguity)
Learner still has three ApprenticeshipLearning rows
The ambiguous PUT returns 202 rather than throwing
None of the three standard-21 episodes were touched — all still approved, not removed, and carry no withdrawal date
